---
name: Good first issue
about: A small, well-scoped task for new contributors
title: "[Good first issue] "
labels: good first issue, help wanted
---

**Task**
A specific, narrow change. Should take less than a few hours.

**Where to start**
File path, function name, or test that needs to be added. Link to the relevant spec section if applicable.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Test added (if applicable)
- [ ] `uv run ruff check src/ tests/` passes
- [ ] `uv run mypy src/` passes
- [ ] `uv run pytest tests/ -v` passes

**Mentor**
Optional: who to ping for questions.
